_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

units.spark: degrees BTDC = x / 2 (signed tables: two's complement)
units.pos256: position 0-255 along the rows (or columns) of a 3D table
units.tempdiff: deg C = x (a difference of two temperatures)

03FC.name: BaroUpdateMapOffset
03FC.desc: Barometric pressure update while running: offset added to MAP against engine rpm (throttle above $04C1)

0581.name: ResetCoolantInit
0581.desc: At reset: IdleRpmRefStart against start coolant temperature; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0593.name: CrankEthanolScale
0593.desc: Cranking: flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of CrankEthanolCoolant

059B.name: PartThrottleMapScale
059B.desc: MAP to row position of the part-throttle spark and fuel tables

05A7.name: WotMapScale
05A7.desc: MAP to row position of the WOT spark and fuel tables

05CB.name: DecelMapScale
05CB.desc: Corrected MAP to row position of DecelMapRpmLimit

0643.name: DecelLeanRpmScale
0643.desc: Deceleration enleanment: rpm to row position of DecelLeanAirflow

064F.name: DecelLeanThrottleScale
064F.desc: Deceleration enleanment: throttle opening to column position of DecelLeanAirflow

065B.name: DecelLeanTimeScale
065B.desc: Deceleration enleanment: time since start to row position of DecelLeanTimeCoolant

0673.name: PurgeFuelMapScale
0673.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: MAP to row position of PurgeFuelBase

067D.name: PurgeFuelRpm
067D.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: engine rpm to column position of PurgeFuelBase

05F7.name: CoolantSparkMapScale
05F7.desc: MAP to row position of CoolantSparkMap

0693.name: AirTempSparkMapScale
0693.desc: MAP to row position of AirTempSparkMapRpm

069F.name: AfterStartSparkMapScale
069F.desc: MAP to row position of AfterStartSparkMapRpm

06AB.name: SurgeMapScale
06AB.desc: Driveline surge spark control (SurgeControl): MAP to row position (Scratch6, SurgeMapPos)

06B7.name: SurgeDecayGearScale
06B7.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm/speed ratio (gear) to row position of SurgeDecay

06C3.name: KnockRetardMapScale
06C3.desc: MAP to row position of KnockRetardLimit

06DB.name: IacRollThrottleScale
06DB.desc: IAC target while rolling: throttle opening to row position of IacRollThrottleRpm

06E7.name: IacCoastSpeedScale
06E7.desc: Vehicle speed to row position of IacCoastSpeedRpm

06F3.name: IacFieldDutyScale
06F3.desc: Filtered duty of the CS2 input $106E.5 (probably the generator field) to row position of IacFieldDutyRpm

06FF.name: IacBaroScale
06FF.desc: Barometric pressure to row position of IacBaseBaroTarget and IdleMapBase

0758.name: CrankPulseCoolantFactor
0758.desc: Factor on the cranking pulse against the cranking coolant, result into CrankPulseCoolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0764.name: CrankBasePulse
0764.desc: Cranking base pulse width: ethanol content (FlexEthanolScaled, rows) x cranking coolant temperature (columns); squared, then reduced by the decay factors below; into CrankPulse

07CB.name: CrankRpmDecayClosed
07CB.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm with the throttle closed

07D5.name: CrankRpmDecayWeight
07D5.desc: Weight of the rpm reduction against the cranking coolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

07E1.name: CrankV0769Decay
07E1.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against CrankDecayIndex; weighted by CrankV0769DecayWeight

07ED.name: CrankV0769DecayWeight
07ED.desc: Weight of CrankV0769Decay against the cranking coolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

07F9.name: CrankCoolantAdder2
07F9.desc: Cranking pulse addition against the cranking coolant, used while BatteryTemp is not above the raw MAP; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0803.name: CrankBaroDecay
0803.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against barometric pressure; weighted by CrankBaroDecayWeight; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

080B.name: CrankBaroDecayWeight
080B.desc: Weight of CrankBaroDecay against the cranking coolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0813.name: CrankVacuumFactor
0813.desc: Cranking pulse factor against manifold vacuum

081F.name: CrankEthanolCoolant
081F.desc: Cranking: value against ethanol content and coolant into CrankEthanolFactor; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0840.name: CrankCoolantAdder
0840.desc: Cranking: added to the coolant temperature against the number of crank events (CrankEvents), limited to $0B75; result is the cranking coolant CrankCoolant

08AA.name: InjectionModeRpmFactor
08AA.desc: Factor against rpm on the bank pulse (FuelPulseBank1 / FuelPulseBank2) during the change of injection mode in FuelEventSchedule

08B4.name: PartThrottleFuel
08B4.desc: Part-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0B1E.name: MapBaroOffset
0B1E.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before the part-throttle MAP scale (main-loop fuel, EgrControl, diagnostics)

0B51.name: DecelBaroMapOffset
0B51.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before DecelMapScale

0B5B.name: DecelMapRpmLimit
0B5B.desc: Deceleration fuel reduction: MAP x rpm threshold; with the throttle closed, values under it ramp DecelFuelFactor (DecelFuelFactor) in

0C08.name: FuelEventRpmAdder
0C08.desc: Pulse width added against rpm while SparkFlags2 bit 7 is set (result x 8)

0C1F.name: WotTimeEnrichMax
0C1F.desc: Maximum of the WOT enrichment that builds up after a sustained WOT (WotTimeEnrich), against rpm

0C29.name: WotFuel
0C29.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0849.name: BaroFuel
0849.desc: Pulse width added to the fuel pulse against barometric pressure (result x 8); read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

113D.name: TpsFilterRiseCoolant
113D.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast (TpsFilterCoef) while the throttle opens, against coolant at start; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

11FB.name: DecelLeanThrottleCoolantFactor
11FB.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the throttle-closing term against coolant at start, into DecelLeanThrottleFactor; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

120D.name: DecelLeanMapCoolantFactor
120D.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the MAP-drop term against coolant at start, into DecelLeanMapFactor; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

1227.name: TpsFilterFallCoolant
1227.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast (TpsFilterCoef) while the throttle closes, against coolant at start; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

1239.name: DecelLeanBaroFactor
1239.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against barometric pressure; the result, limited by $158A, is DecelLeanFuel; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

1245.name: DecelLeanMapAdder
1245.desc: Deceleration enleanment: added to DecelLeanRpmFactor against MAP

1259.name: DecelLeanRpmFactor
1259.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against rpm (with DecelLeanMapAdder)

126D.name: DecelLeanAirflow
126D.desc: Deceleration enleanment: airflow value against rpm and throttle position; the drop between last and current throttle goes to DecelLeanAir

130D.name: DecelLeanTimeCoolant
130D.desc: Deceleration enleanment shortly after start: time x coolant at start, into DecelLeanTimeFactor; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

1374.name: EventFuelCoolantSub
1374.desc: Per-event fuel: amount subtracted from FuelPulseAdder against coolant while FuelModeFlags bit 7 is set; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

13B9.name: O2StartDelayCoolant
13B9.desc: Closed-loop entry (O2StartDelays): delay against coolant (plus $323D with an O2 fault flag); read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

13FC.name: O2PurgeLimit
13FC.desc: Closed loop: limit of O2PurgeCount against the purge ramp PurgeRamp

141F.name: O2VoltageScale
141F.desc: Upstream O2 sensor ADC counts to the value used by closed loop and its monitor

142F.name: O2VoltageScale2
142F.desc: Second copy of the O2 voltage scale (same values as O2VoltageScale)

1566.name: O2StepScale
1566.desc: Closed loop: trim step against the size of the O2 error Scratch3 (doubled while purge is active and duty is zero)

1610.name: DecelCutRpmFactor
1610.desc: Factor on the fuel pulse while the deceleration cut-off flag (FuelModeFlags2 bit 7) is set, against rpm above the idle target

16F8.name: PurgeFuelBase
16F8.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction base against MAP (rows) and rpm (columns, normalised lookup); multiplied by the learned vapor value PurgeVaporClosed

1766.name: AfterStartSparkMin
1766.desc: Lower limit of the spark change against time since start (SparkStartTime), into Temp4FC

19DC.name: CoolantSparkMap
19DC.desc: Spark change against MAP (rows) and coolant (columns), signed; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

1A39.name: AirTempSparkFactor
1A39.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMapRpm against intake air temperature (or BatteryTemp with calibration bit Options0330 bit 5 clear)

1A43.name: AirTempSparkMapRpm
1A43.desc: Spark change for intake air temperature, MAP x rpm (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor

1A82.name: AfterStartSparkCoolant
1A82.desc: Spark change after start against the coolant temperature at start, into AfterStartSparkStart; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

1A98.name: AfterStartSparkCoolantWeight
1A98.desc: Weight of AfterStartSparkMapRpm against coolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

1AA4.name: AfterStartSparkMapRpm
1AA4.desc: Spark change after start, MAP x rpm (signed), weighted by AfterStartSparkCoolantWeight

1B11.name: DecelSpark
1B11.desc: Spark change against the deceleration fuel factor (DecelFuelFactor), signed

1B1F.name: HighSpeedSparkRpm
1B1F.desc: Spark retard against engine rpm above coarse vehicle speed $1FA6 (hysteresis $1FA5)

1CAD.name: SurgeJerkRetardOpen
1CAD.desc: Driveline surge spark control, throttle open: retard against positive rpm jerk (above $2173)

1CB5.name: SurgeJerkAdvanceOpen
1CB5.desc: Driveline surge spark control, throttle open: spark against negative rpm jerk (below $2172)

1CCE.name: SurgeRateThreshold
1CCE.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm acceleration (RpmAccel) that starts the retard, against the rpm/speed ratio (gear)

1CDC.name: SurgeRetardGearFactor
1CDC.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the base retard against the rpm/speed ratio (gear)

1CEA.name: SurgeRetardRateFactor
1CEA.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against rpm acceleration RpmAccel

1CF6.name: SurgeRetardMapRiseFactor
1CF6.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against MAP rise MapRise (MAP minus filtered MAP); result into SurgeRetard

1D02.name: SurgeRetardBase
1D02.desc: Driveline surge spark control: base retard (SurgeRetardRaw) against MAP position (rows) and the fast segment rpm SegmentRpmFast (columns)

1D23.name: SurgeDecay
1D23.desc: Driveline surge spark control: decay factor of the retard against gear (rows) and time in the decay stage SurgeStageTime (columns)

1D5C.name: SurgeJerkThreshold
1D5C.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm jerk (RpmJerk) above which the jerk retard applies, against the rpm/speed ratio

1D6A.name: SurgeRetardCoolantFactor
1D6A.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against coolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

1D74.name: SurgeJerkGain
1D74.desc: Driveline surge spark control: jerk retard gain against MAP position (rows) and fast rpm (columns)

1D95.name: SurgeJerkLimit
1D95.desc: Driveline surge spark control: limit of the jerk retard against MAP position (rows) and fast rpm (columns), into SurgeJerkRetard

1DF3.name: AcSparkRateUp
1DF3.desc: A/C spark compensation: spark against positive rpm rate RpmRate, into AcSpark

1DFB.name: AcSparkRateDown
1DFB.desc: As AcSparkRateUp against negative rpm rate, A/C clutch off

1E03.name: AcSparkRateDownAcOn
1E03.desc: As AcSparkRateDown with the A/C clutch on

1E0B.name: AcSparkMapLimit
1E0B.desc: Limit of the A/C spark compensation against MAP

1F6B.name: KnockNoiseLearnWeight
1F6B.desc: Filter weight of the learned knock noise level per rpm band (KnockNoiseLevel)

1F85.name: KnockNoiseMin
1F85.desc: Lower limit of the learned knock noise level against engine rpm

1F91.name: KnockNoiseMax
1F91.desc: Upper limit of the learned knock noise level against engine rpm

1FA5.name: KnockThreshold
1FA5.desc: Knock sensor voltage threshold against rpm

1FB3.name: KnockRetardStep
1FB3.desc: Knock retard step against the knock signal above the threshold (KnockSignal minus KnockThresholdNow); the value is multiplied by KnockFirstStepFactor or KnockStepFactor

1FBF.name: KnockRetardMaxMap
1FBF.desc: Maximum knock retard (KnockRetardMax) against MAP (above throttle $24A5 or below rpm $24A6)

1FD9.name: KnockRetardLimit
1FD9.desc: Knock retard against MAP (rows) and rpm; signed; result scaled by the current knock level into $0D04

417E.name: KnockRetardMaxRpm
417E.desc: Limit of the per-cylinder knock retard (KnockCylRetardMax) against engine rpm

2053.name: O2SparkTrimPos
2053.desc: Spark change against the short-term trim above its average (closed loop, part throttle), into O2SparkTrim

2061.name: O2SparkTrimNeg
2061.desc: Spark change against the short-term trim below its average

20D3.name: AirTempSparkFactor2
20D3.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMap against intake air temperature

20DD.name: AirTempSparkMap
20DD.desc: Second air-temperature spark term against MAP (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor2

2234.name: IacGearDelayCoolant
2234.desc: Delay timer (IacGearDelay) started when DriveFlags bit 7 sets, against coolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

223E.name: IacGearDelayCoolantAC
223E.desc: As IacGearDelayCoolant with A/C requested; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

2248.name: IacGearTimeCoolant
2248.desc: Duration of the gear-change idle air (IacGearDuration) against coolant, below $279A; scaled by IacGearTimeFactor; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

2252.name: IacGearTimeCoolantAC
2252.desc: As IacGearTimeCoolant with A/C requested; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

225C.name: IacGearTimeFactor
225C.desc: Factor on IacGearTimeCoolant against the time counter IacGearTime

2270.name: IacDroopStepCoolant
2270.desc: IAC opening when the rpm drops below the target in gear (IdleFlags3 bit 3, DriveFlags bit 7), against coolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

227A.name: IacDroopStepCoolantAC
227A.desc: As IacDroopStepCoolant with A/C requested; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

2294.name: IacGearTimeCoolantPN
2294.desc: As IacGearTimeCoolant in P/N; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

229E.name: IacGearTimeCoolantPNAC
229E.desc: As IacGearTimeCoolant in P/N with A/C requested; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

22B2.name: IacGearTimeFactorPNAC
22B2.desc: As IacGearTimeFactor in P/N with A/C requested

22BC.name: IacGearStepCoolantPN
22BC.desc: IAC step when the gear-change timer runs out, against coolant (P/N); read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

22C6.name: IacGearStepCoolantPNAC
22C6.desc: As IacGearStepCoolantPN with A/C requested; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

22E1.name: IacAcKickMap
22E1.desc: IAC step when the A/C clutch engages, against MAP (MAP latched into IacAcKickMapLatch); into IacKick; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

22E9.name: IacAcKickMapLatched
22E9.desc: IAC step when the A/C clutch releases, against the MAP latched at engagement (IacAcKickMapLatch); read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

2316.name: IacStartBattTemp
2316.desc: IAC hold at start (IacStartHold/IacStartHold2) against battery temperature, scaled by IacStepBaroFactor; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

2349.name: IacRunTimeAdder
2349.desc: IAC addition against time since start

2351.name: IacCoastCoolant
2351.desc: Minimum idle air while coasting against coolant; the higher of this and IacCoastSpeedRpm applies; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

235F.name: IacCoastThrottleLimit
235F.desc: Throttle opening limit for the coasting idle air

236D.name: IacRollSpeedBase
236D.desc: IAC target while rolling: base against vehicle speed

2379.name: IacRollFactorAcSensor
2379.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against the filtered A/C sensor AcSensorFiltered (centred on 128), with calibration bit Options0331 bit 7

2385.name: IacRollFactorBattTemp
2385.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against battery temperature (centred on 128); read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

238F.name: IacRollRpmFactor2
238F.desc: Second rolling IAC factor against segment rpm; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

2399.name: IacRollRpmFactor
2399.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against segment rpm; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

23A3.name: IacRollThrottleRpm
23A3.desc: IAC target while rolling: addition against throttle (rows) and segment rpm (signed); result into IacTarget limited by $2642

23C4.name: IacCoastSpeedRpm
23C4.desc: Minimum idle air while coasting against vehicle speed (rows) and segment rpm

2421.name: IacStepBaroFactor
2421.desc: Multiplier on IAC steps and start positions against barometric pressure; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

242B.name: IacShiftBaroFactor
242B.desc: Multiplier on the gear-change IAC step and the initial IAC value against barometric pressure; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

2435.name: IacKickBaroFactor
2435.desc: Factor on the A/C and rpm-dip IAC steps against barometric pressure

2445.name: IacChargeStep
2445.desc: IAC opening step against the charging deficit ChargeDeficit (target charging voltage minus battery voltage)

244F.name: IacFieldDutyRpm
244F.desc: IAC addition against field duty (rows) and segment rpm (columns), into Scratch4

24E8.name: IacFieldDutyRpm2
24E8.desc: Second field-duty table against segment rpm, into Scratch7 (MAP offset for the learned idle MAP)

2509.name: IdleMapBase
2509.desc: Base of the idle MAP target (IdleMapTarget, via Scratch5): barometric pressure (rows) and idle target rpm (columns)

254C.name: IacStartBaro
254C.desc: Idle air position at reset against barometric pressure, into IdleMapLearned

2564.name: IacBaseBaroTarget
2564.desc: Base idle air (IAC position) against barometric pressure (rows) and the idle target (columns), into IacBase; added to the IAC target

267A.name: SpeedCtlOverrideThrottle
267A.desc: Value SpeedCtlOverrideCmd against throttle above the level latched in SpeedCtlShiftThrottle (driver override)

070B.name: MisfireLoadScale
070B.desc: Misfire monitor: load MisfireLoad to row position of the misfire thresholds

0717.name: MisfireWeightLoadScale
0717.desc: Load to row position of MisfireWeight

072F.name: MisfireCoolantLoadScale
072F.desc: Load to row position of MisfireThreshCoolant

26E3.name: MisfireThresh
26E3.desc: Misfire threshold of the segment-time change against load (rows) and segment rpm MisfireRpmCol (columns), P/N

2740.name: MisfireNoiseRef
2740.desc: Reference for the filtered segment-time change (MisfireNoiseLevel) against load and segment rpm; selects MisfireThreshNoisy

279D.name: MisfireThreshNoisy
279D.desc: As MisfireThresh when the filtered change MisfireChangeFiltered is at or above MisfireNoiseRef

27FA.name: MisfireWeight
27FA.desc: Counter weight of a detected misfire (Temp4FE) against load (rows) and segment rpm (columns)

2857.name: MisfireWeight2
2857.desc: Second counter weight (Temp4FF) against the first weight and segment rpm

28B4.name: MisfireThreshCoolant
28B4.desc: Factor on the misfire threshold against load (rows) and coolant (columns), result into MisfireThreshValue; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

28D5.name: MisfireHoldSegRpm
28D5.desc: Hold-off after a detected misfire (MisfireHold) against segment rpm

290F.name: MisfireDevCurve2
290F.desc: Second curve on the deviation, multiplied with MisfireDevCurve

2921.name: MisfireDevCurve
2921.desc: Misfire monitor: curve on the segment-time deviation Temp4F6 (calibration bit $2CC1.3)

2AA0.name: LdpPumpTimeByLevel
2AA0.desc: Leak detection pump, pump-up state: state time limit (LdpStateTime) against fuel level

2AAC.name: LdpPumpTimeByLevel2
2AAC.desc: As LdpPumpTimeByLevel with LdpFlags3 bit 1 set

2B24.name: FuelSysLimitScale
2B24.desc: Fuel system monitor (FuelSysTooRich1Check, FuelSysTooRich2Check): purge ramp PurgeRamp to row position of FuelSysLimit

413E.name: MapLimpFromThrottle
413E.desc: Substitute MAP from the throttle position when the MAP sensor has failed

1F79.name: KnockSensorCheckRpm
1F79.desc: Minimum filtered knock signal for the sensor check (KnockSensorCheck) against engine rpm

4247.name: ThermistorCold
4247.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, cold range (-55 to 83 C), used after the pull-up is switched

4257.name: ThermistorHot
4257.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, hot range (13 to 127 C); coolant and intake air

4261.name: Thermistor3Curve
4261.desc: ADC counts of a third thermistor input (BatteryTempRaw or BusTempRaw3) to temperature, into Temp3

4277.name: Thermistor3CurveAlt
4277.desc: Alternative curve for the third thermistor input, chosen by calibration bit Options0330 bit 2

4289.name: ChargeVoltsBattTemp
4289.desc: Charging voltage target (ChargeTargetVolts) against battery temperature, limited by $7087/$7088

4295.name: AcSensorCurve
4295.desc: A/C sensor (probably refrigerant pressure): ADC AcSensorRaw to AcSensor

42AD.name: CatTempSensorCurve
42AD.desc: Catalyst temperature sensor (Options0330 bit 4; CatTempMonitor reports P1482/P1483 shorted low/high and P1484 overheat): analog input $0A8E to CatTempFiltered. The same input serves the flex-fuel sensor (FlexSensorCheck, P0176/P0178/P0179) where that is fitted

42BF.name: DwellRpmScale
42BF.desc: Rpm to column position of DwellTime

42D3.name: DwellVoltsScale
42D3.desc: Battery voltage to row position of DwellTime; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

42E7.name: DwellTime
42E7.desc: Coil dwell against battery voltage and rpm (both as positions)

FD53.name: EventTimingLimit
FD53.desc: Output-compare set-up in the GPT IC1 interrupt: limit against SparkAdvanceD11 compared with RefPeriodLow

FD65.name: FuelEventOffset
FD65.desc: Per-event fuel offset against the calibration value $0A83 (or $7563 with bit Options0338 bit 2), added before the per-cylinder table $ABC3

0311.name: CalTypeCode
0311.desc: Header byte (7): copied to CalTypeCopy at reset, plus 4 when it is 5 or more and Options032E bit 7 is set (no reader of $0059 found)

0323.name: Options032A
0323.desc: Option byte; bit tests in the reference-event and spark code (bits 7-6: spark cap and ignition variants)

0324.name: Options032E
0324.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0325.name: Options032C
0325.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0326.name: Options032D
0326.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0329.name: Options032F
0329.desc: Option byte; bit tests in the event, fuel and closed-loop code (bits 2-1: output timing set-up)

032B.name: Options0331
032B.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

032C.name: Options0335
032C.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

032D.name: Options0334
032D.desc: Option byte (bit 4: output-compare set-up at reset and in the PIT code)

032E.name: Options0337
032E.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

032F.name: Options0338
032F.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0330.name: Options0339
0330.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0331.name: Options033A
0331.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0335.name: Options033E
0335.desc: Option byte copied to Options033ECopy at reset; bit 1 selects branches in the start and closed-loop code

0336.name: Options033F
0336.desc: Option byte copied to Options033FCopy at reset; bits 7-4 enable monitor branches in ObdReadiness and O2HeaterMonitor

0338.name: Options0340
